overall_goal: Tidy the kitchen, log the nutritional value of the spaghetti, and stir the food in the wok.

goals.description: Cover the wok and tidy the kitchen counter.
goals.rationale: The person covers the wok with a pan and then organizes items on the counter, including moving bottles and folding a tea towel.

goals.description: Retrieve the spaghetti and scan its barcode.
goals.rationale: The person takes the spaghetti out of the cabinet and uses their phone to scan its barcode for nutritional logging.

goals.description: Weigh the spaghetti and log its nutritional value.
goals.rationale: The person opens the spaghetti, weighs it on the kitchen scale, logs the weight in their phone app, and transfers the pasta to a bowl.
The person disposes of the empty spaghetti packaging by putting the seal in a drawer and throwing the plastic in the trash.

goals.description: Uncover, stir, and recover the food in the wok.
goals.rationale: The person removes the pan covering the wok, stirs the ingredients with a spatula, and then covers the wok again.
